change: Develop one event-driven challenger using descriptor-relative confinement and the corrected parser. Keep all socket buffers bounded and time out stalled reads and writes.
evidence: The parser-only paired benchmark was inconclusive: all workloads ineligible, with both candidates exhibiting failures and some zero-throughput rounds. No speedup or promotion can be inferred.
hypothesis: Thread creation per connection and a small listen backlog can consume CPU and fail under 4096 concurrent clients; a bounded nonblocking epoll loop with sendfile and larger backlog should improve reliability and reduce copying.
next_action: Submit the event-driven challenger, run public checks, then compare with the incumbent if it is fully accepted.
verdict: Parser fix remains unpromoted. Investigate service architecture rather than repeat the unchanged comparison.
